landing.heroBadge: AI-native HR platform — now in public beta
landing.heroTitle: Hire smarter with <highlight>AI that works</highlight> like your best recruiter
landing.heroDescription: Owlky automates screening, surfaces top talent, and eliminates busywork — so your HR team can focus on people, not paperwork.
landing.featuresDescription: One platform to recruit, onboard, and retain — powered by AI at every step.
landing.feature1Description: Automatically rank and filter candidates based on job fit, culture alignment, and skill signals — before a human ever reviews a resume.
landing.feature2Description: Surface the right talent from your pipeline with semantic search that understands context, not just keywords.
landing.feature3Description: Keep your whole team aligned with structured interview scorecards, async feedback, and real-time decision tracking.
landing.feature4Description: Track hiring velocity, diversity metrics, and retention signals in one unified dashboard built for HR teams.
landing.feature5Description: Stay audit-ready with GDPR-compliant data handling, EEO tracking, and automated record retention policies.
landing.feature6Description: Eliminate repetitive tasks — offer letters, background check triggers, onboarding sequences — all on autopilot.
landing.howItWorksDescription: No lengthy setup. No consultants. Just results.
landing.step1Description: Integrate with your ATS, HRIS, and job boards in minutes. No engineering required.
landing.step2Title: Let AI do the heavy lifting
landing.step2Description: Owlky screens, scores, and surfaces the best-fit candidates automatically from the moment a role goes live.
landing.step3Description: Make data-driven decisions, reduce time-to-hire by up to 60%, and build teams that last.
landing.pricingDescription: Start free. Scale when you're ready. Cancel anytime.
landing.starterDescription: For small teams getting started with smarter hiring.
landing.growthDescription: For scaling companies that hire continuously.

landing.testimonial1Quote: Owlky cut our time-to-hire in half. The AI screening alone saves our team 20+ hours per week on every role we open.
landing.testimonial2Quote: We went from 300 applicants to a shortlist of 12 in under an hour. The signal quality is unlike anything we've used before.
landing.testimonial3Quote: Finally an HR tool that thinks like a recruiter. The workflow automations alone paid for the subscription in week one.
